symptoms.symptom: The refrigeration unit is switching on more frequently and for longer. A layer of frost forms on the back wall of the refrigerator compartment.

causes.label: The appliance has been opened frequently.
remedies: Do not open appliance door unnecessarily.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "The appliance has been opened frequently."

causes.label: External ventilation openings are covered up.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "External ventilation openings are covered up."

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
Install the appliance as far away as possible from heating elements, cookers and other heat sources.
Avoid prolonged exposure of the appliance to direct sunlight.
Only open the appliance door as briefly as necessary.
Allow hot food and drinks to cool down first before storing in the appliance.

Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently."

symptoms.symptom: Side panels of the appliance are warm.

causes.label: Not a fault. The side panels contain pipes which heat up during the cooling process. Units touching the appliance will not be damaged by the heat. No action required.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 19: "Not a fault. The side panels contain pipes which heat up during the cooling process. Units touching the appliance will not be damaged by the heat. No action required."

causes.label: The water contained in warm and humid air condenses on the colder surfaces of the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 19: "The water contained in warm and humid air condenses on the colder surfaces of the appliance."

causes.label: The appliance is not level.
remedies: Align the appliance using a spirit level and the screw feet.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 19: "The appliance is not level."

causes.label: The appliance is not free-standing.
remedies: Observe the minimum clearances for the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 19: "The appliance is not free-standing."

causes.label: Fittings wobble or stick.
remedies: Check the removable fittings and, if required, replace these.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 19: "Fittings wobble or stick."

causes.label: Bottles or containers are touching.
remedies: Move the bottles or containers away from each other.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 19: "Bottles or containers are touching."
